definitions.revenue: Booked gross dollars; not profit or causal incremental revenue.
definitions.margin_preservation: Recovered gross margin / full original gross margin of all cancelled slots.
definitions.unnecessary_discount_rate: Among slots that fill under no recovery using the same latent random draws, fraction exposed to any discount by this policy.
definitions.time: Conditional on successful fill, simulated minutes from cancellation.
definitions.confidence_interval: Paired bootstrap over synthetic scenarios; excludes real-market/model uncertainty.

limitations: Not real merchants, customers, demand, or recovered money.
Outcome generator and forecast share a functional family; latent noise and elasticity sensitivity reduce but do not remove circularity.
All strategies use the same scenarios, time steps, latent demand and random draws.
Channel expansion is part of the agent policy, so the comparison does not isolate LLM reasoning or price effects.
No LLM participates in these numerical simulations; they evaluate the deterministic recovery policy.
